description_en: Creates a custom enterprise role. After binding employees to the role, you can select employees in batches by role in the enterprise management console. This is commonly used for configurations such as permission granting and travel policy scope
description_zh: 通过本接口可以创建企业自定义角色，完成员工与角色绑定后，可以在企业管理后台按照角色进行批量选人，多用于权限授予、差标生效范围等配置
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen create-custom-role --role-id role_1234 --role-name '华东地区日常出差' --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCustomRole

parameters.help_en:
The custom role ID.
This is the unique identifier of the role. Ensure that the value is unique for each request
parameters.help_zh:
自定义角色 ID。
是角色的唯一标识，请保证每次传入参数的唯一性
parameters.name: role_id

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.

This is a required header parameter for HTTP calls. For information about how to obtain it, refer to: Enterprise Access Token (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985).
You can use `corp_token=value` in the request URL as an alternative
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。

是 HTTP 调用方式的 header 必填参数之一，获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985)。
可以在请求地址中使用 `corp_token=value` 替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token

requestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

traceId.description_en: The global trace ID of the request, typically used for troubleshooting
traceId.description_zh: 跟踪请求全局的标识符，通常用于问题排查定位
